scoring_justification: Result-level comparison with the paper's predicted ballistic-model values (Table II) is the strongest feasible tier because the raw computational artifacts of the full simulation are not submitted; only the extracted parameters are available for verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for predicted I-V parameters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table II of the paper 'Elastic scattering centers in resonant tunneling diodes', Appl. Phys. Lett. 53, 201 (1988).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Direct transcription of the paper's reported predicted values; the source is a publicly available journal article.

outputs.description: Predicted I-V parameters from ballistic transport model for each well doping profile.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the entire simulation from scratch; no precomputed artifacts are provided. Parameters (layer thicknesses, doping profiles, Fermi energy, temperature) are specified in the step action. The compensated doping case is excluded from the scored target because it was not tabulated in the paper's predicted results.
